custom_checks.name: eligible_rows_receive_exact_fallback
custom_checks.sql: SELECT COUNTIF(qa_v3_row_type = 'planned_only_package_date' AND NULLIF(_planned_impressions, 0) IS NOT NULL AND (qa_media_data_type = 'tv' OR _channel_group IN ('linear', 'print', 'ooh', 'ooh_d') OR _channel IN ('linear_tv', 'print', 'ooh', 'ooh_d') OR LOWER(COALESCE(_media_name, '')) IN ('tv', 'print', 'magazine', 'newspaper', 'ooh')) AND (_impressions IS DISTINCT FROM _planned_impressions OR (_planned_spend IS NOT NULL AND _spend IS DISTINCT FROM _planned_spend))) AS value FROM {table}
